description: Source code for entity clustering and base clustering management in the game Unvanquished, including classes for spatial clustering of game entities and functions for managing base beacons for teams.

classes.name: Clustering::EntityClustering
classes.description: Handles spatial clustering of game entities using Euclidean distance, with PVS visibility checks.

methods.name: EntityClustering::Update
methods.description: Updates the cluster with a new entity position.

methods.name: EntityClustering::edgeVisPVS
methods.description: Checks if two entities are visible within the Potential Visibility Set (PVS).

methods.name: BaseClustering::Init
methods.description: Resets all base clusterings and beacons for both teams.

methods.name: BaseClustering::Update
methods.description: Adds or updates a buildable beacon in the clustering system.

methods.name: BaseClustering::Remove
methods.description: Removes a buildable beacon from the clustering system.
